sources.title: antfarm src/installer/agent-cron.ts
sources.locator: buildPollingPrompt lines128-157; setupAgentCrons lines160-195; active-run cron lifecycle lines203-249
sources.finding: The polling agent claims a step and calls sessions_spawn with the assigned agentId and model. Product setup registers enabled OpenClaw every-interval agentTurn cron jobs; concurrent active runs keep the workflow crons alive.

sources.title: antfarm src/installer/gateway-api.ts
sources.finding: Uses the local OpenClaw gateway on127.0.0.1 with configured token or password in a Bearer header, and falls back to the openclaw cron CLI. This is control-plane authentication, not evidence of a coding-agent subscription.

sources.title: antfarm workflows/feature-dev/workflow.yml
sources.locator: agents; plan; setup lines116-145; implement loop; pr lines301-329; review lines331-389
sources.finding: Feature workflow defines planner, setup, developer, verifier, tester and reviewer roles, creates a Git branch in the supplied repo, persists story/result handoffs and instructs gh PR creation and review. It is a workflow instruction contract, not tested enforcement.

sources.title: antfarm src/installer/run.ts
sources.locator: startWorkflow function: INSERT INTO runs and steps; initial status running/pending
sources.finding: Starting a workflow creates durable run and step records and enables its agent polling jobs.
